thread:
Lina Gomez: opened PR for offline installer docs: adds checksum verification, PKCS#11 path examples for HSMs, and an MTU troubleshooting section. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4621

Ethan Brooks: thanks! can we standardize on sha512 for the offline bundle? some customers requested stronger checksums.

Lina Gomez: leaning sha512 yes, but adding both sha256 and sha512 in the metadata for compatibility. will show how to verify with openssl and sha512sum.

Priya Rao: also add GPG-signed manifest example and a tiny verify script. ops love that.

Lina Gomez: added sample verify script:```bash
# verify bundle and signature
sha512sum -c bundle-1.2.3.sha512 || exit 1
gpg --verify bundle-1.2.3.tar.gz.sig bundle-1.2.3.tar.gz || exit 1
```

Ethan Brooks: for PKCS#11 path examples, include both vendor path and the common /usr/lib/ for linux-amd64. a lot of on-prem HSMs expose different filenames.

Lina Gomez: included; example config snippet in the PR:```yaml
kms:
  provider: pkcs11
  pkcs11:
    library_path: /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
    slot: 0
    token_label: "redwood-hsm"
```

Priya Rao: add a systemd unit tweak for HSM sidecar: set Restart=on-failure and add `TimeoutStartSec=60` for slow devices.

Lina Gomez: done. also added a WARN box: do not expose PKCS#11 endpoints directly to the public internet. mention firewalling and private peering. :no_entry_sign:

Ethan Brooks: another painful class of issues: MTU/fragmentation with overlay networks (flannel/calico) causing TLS record truncation to HSM. please include how to detect (tcpdump + tcpdump -vvv) and fix (adjust MTU on veth or enable tcp_mtu_probing).

Lina Gomez: added quick troubleshooting steps:```bash
# check MTU
ip link show dev eth0
# enable kernel path MTU probing
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1
```

Priya Rao: nice. for customers using cloud VPC peering, a short Terraform example to add a route to the HSM gateway would help. keep it minimal.

Lina Gomez: added Terraform snippet under "VPC & routing examples":```hcl
resource "aws_route" "to_hsm" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.private.id
  destination_cidr_block = "10.2.0.0/24"
  vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer.id
}
```

Ethan Brooks: also show a security group example allowing the 4731 port only from the private subnet.

Lina Gomez: added SG example.```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_hsm" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 4731
  to_port     = 4731
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.2.0.0/24"]
}
```

docs-link-bot: ERROR: internal link check failed in PR 4621 - broken anchor to #pkcs11-paths.

Lina Gomez: whoops, anchor slug changed when I moved the PKCS#11 section. fixing anchors and adding redirects from the old path /private/install/hsm to /private/install/hsm-pkcs11.

Priya Rao: can we include a small Go SDK snippet that shows configuring a client to use the local sidecar for private installs? I'll paste one:```go
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "time"
  "github.com/redwood/sdk"
)
func main() {
  httpc := &http.Client{Timeout: 15 * time.Second}
  client := sdk.NewClient(sdk.Config{APIKey: "REDACTED", BaseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:8080", HTTPClient: httpc})
  resp, _ := client.Generate("hi")
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```

Lina Gomez: added that under SDK snippets and a note about setting REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT for local testing. tagged infra and security for quick review.

deploy-bot: INFO: staging deploy will pick up doc changes once merged.

Lina Gomez: final checklist before merge: sha512+sha256 examples, GPG verify script, PKCS#11 library paths + systemd note, MTU troubleshooting, Terraform route & SG, Go SDK snippet, and internal link fixes. Sasha, Priya, Ethan: any last asks?

Ethan Brooks: looks good from my side. one tiny nit: spell out that tcp_mtu_probing is a temporary mitigation; long-term fix is proper MTU across overlays.

Priya Rao: approve after nit. I'll do a quick pass on phrasing.

Lina Gomez: thanks — merging once PR passes lint and docs CI. will open a follow-up thread if support sees more HSM-related tickets. :shipit:
